setting: Lower Dnipro, August 1635: the Zaporozhian Sich island, the plavni reed marshes and steppe ravines upriver, and the newly built Kodak fortress on a cliff above the Kodak rapid (right bank). Kodak fortress (a new star-shaped earthwork fort on a steep clay-and-granite cliff above the Dnipro, raw yellow-brown earthen rampart topped with a palisade of sharpened oak stakes, deep ditch, two small river bastions with gun embrasures); inside: the small inner wooden fortlet of Kodak with heavy timber gates, plank barracks and a turf-covered powder cellar. Hot late summer, horseflies, feather grass; the assaults happen in late afternoon to sunset, the aftermath at night and dawn. Cossacks travel in baidaks (long open wooden oared Cossack boats, mast lowered, their sides lashed with tall bundles of fresh green reeds rising a full man's height so each boat looks like a floating island of reeds), small dugout canoes (dovbanky) and on small steppe horses.

characters.ivan_sulyma: Ivan Sulyma, 50-year-old Zaporozhian hetman, broad weathered face, long grey drooping mustache, shaved head with a grey-black forelock, scar over left eyebrow, stocky powerful build, crimson zhupan, black sash, dark blue sharovary, red leather boots, kalpak with fox-fur trim, shablia at the hip, brass pernach mace in the sash
characters.ivan_hladkyi: Ivan Hladkyi, 35-year-old Cossack kurin otaman, lean wiry build, sunburnt narrow face, hooked nose with a small white scar across the bridge, shaved head with a long dark-brown forelock tucked behind the left ear, long dark-brown drooping mustache, no beard, undyed linen shirt with rolled sleeves, dark green sharovary, faded red sash, worn brown boots, composite bow and leather quiver, shablia
characters.trokhym: Trokhym, 42-year-old head of the Cossack mounted scouts, stocky barrel-chested build, round ruddy face, thick chestnut mustache streaked with grey, cropped hair under a black sheepskin kalpak, dark blue wool zhupan with pushed-up sleeves, wide black sash with a flintlock pistol, yellow boots, long rohach boar spear
characters.stets: Stets, 18-year-old Cossack novice, wiry and gangly, freckled boyish face with a strikingly broad nose and wide flaring nostrils, faint light-brown fuzz of a first mustache, short sandy forelock on a freshly shaved head, coarse undyed linen shirt, grey wool sharovary, thin faded red sash, simple wooden bow and a broad knife at the belt
characters.dmytro: Dmytro, 30-year-old Cossack archer, gaunt hollow-cheeked face, black drooping mustache, black forelock, grey linen shirt, blue sharovary, short horn composite bow
characters.fedir: Fedir, 28-year-old Cossack, broad flat face, long fair drooping mustache, thick neck, big hands
characters.mykhailo: Mykhailo, 25-year-old Cossack, thin dark face, thin black mustache, sharp darting eyes, slight build
characters.neubyikonia: Neubyikonia, 40-year-old giant Zaporozhian Cossack, huge shoulders, shaved head with a thick black forelock, bushy black mustache, broken nose, bare muscular forearms, open-necked linen shirt, bright red sharovary, black sash, wielding a long ash staff topped with a bleached horse skull
characters.jean_marion: Jean Marion, 40-year-old French officer commanding Kodak, tall and thin, pale narrow face, pointed waxed mustache and small pointed goatee, shoulder-length dark wavy hair, wide white linen falling collar, buff leather coat over a dark burgundy doublet, crimson silk sash across the chest, tall cavalier boots, rapier and wheel-lock pistol
characters.red_bearded_mercenary: a big red-bearded German mercenary, about 35, heavy-set, pale sunburnt freckled skin, bushy copper-red beard and close-cropped red hair, linen undershirt open at the neck, loose knee breeches
characters.german_mercenaries: German mercenaries of the 1630s, Thirty Years' War veterans, Western European faces, steel morion and cabasset helmets or wide-brimmed felt hats, buff leather coats and drab slashed doublets, knee breeches and stockings, bandoliers of wooden powder charges, long pikes and matchlock muskets
characters.zaporozhian_cossacks: Zaporozhian Cossacks of varied ages, weathered and sunburnt, shaved heads with forelocks or kalpak hats, long drooping mustaches, linen shirts, wide red, blue and dark green sharovary, coloured sashes, leather boots, samopal muskets, bows, rohach spears and sabres
characters.orthodox_priest: an elderly Orthodox priest, long white beard, black cassock and black skufia cap, brass pectoral cross, worn leather-bound prayer book

palette: sun-bleached ochre and straw-gold feather grass, olive-green reeds, slate-blue Dnipro water, raw yellow-brown clay of fresh earthworks, crimson, dark blue and dark green Cossack wool against drab buff and grey of the mercenaries; sunsets in amber and copper; night scenes in moonlit steel-blue with torch orange
notes: Garrison are Western (German) mercenaries under French officer Jean Marion: morions, buff coats, pikes, matchlocks; in the story they are caught unarmed, sunbathing in linen shirts and breeches (never nude). Cossacks use bows, rohach spears, samopals and shablias; Sulyma carries a pernach. The text is extremely graphic (torture, burning, drowning, mutilated victims): every image implies it only through smoke, fire, distance, silhouettes, reactions and faces; victims (including the murdered Cossack family) are never shown, only shrouded under linen or kept out of frame. Severed heads in the sack stay out of view. Owl call 'pugu-pugu' is the Cossack recognition signal (hands cupped to mouth). No wings, no plate armour.
